call_points.text: Medium-term target is to return EBITDA margins to the 13% to 15% range as volume growth perks up.
Exports revenue targeted to grow by 20% to 25% in FY27 from ₹103 Cr in FY26.
Implemented a 2.0% price increase in January 2026 across the ARGO portfolio, while competitors took zero price hikes.
SLCM volume decline was restricted to 4% in FY26 compared to an estimated 11% decline in the overall construction equipment industry.
Net working capital cycle reduced to 21 days in FY26 with EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion at 142%.
Implemented ~2% price hike in Q4 FY26 to cover cost of production increases from CEV-IV to CEV-V emission norms.
Maintained strong cash chest of ₹1,120.8 Cr with zero debt as of March 2026.
EBITDA to operating cash flow conversion stood at 142% in FY26 with net working capital cycle down to 21 days.
